what: A sees (2, 0) flip to the new witness at the same n with no call, then walks in

repeat.until: (async () => { const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const c = H.worldNow().chunks['2,0']; return c !== undefined && !c.fogged })()

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const n = H.worldNow(); const c = n.chunks['2,0']; const L = S.useLandStore.getState(); const m = L.marks['2,0']; return JSON.stringify({ head: n.head.n, land: L.chunks['2,0']?.status ?? null, sceneName: L.chunks['2,0']?.scene?.name ?? null, live: c ? { id: c.live.id, n: c.live.n, author: n.names[c.live.author] ?? c.live.author, name: c.live.body.index.name, supersedes: c.live.body.supersedes ?? null, npcs: c.live.body.index.npcs.map(p => p.name) } : null, fogged: c?.fogged, legends: c?.legends.map(l => ({ id: l.id, n: l.n, name: l.body.index.name })), marks: m ? { fogged: m.fogged, live: m.live?.name ?? null, legends: m.legends.map(x => x.name) } : null, ignored: n.ignored }) })()
